### Meaning
| infl.   | class      | meaning          |
| ------- | ---------- | ---------------- |
| ~       | *n.*       | blade, knife     |
| ~en'kon | *n. of v.* | cutting          |
| ~en     | *v.*       | to cut, to slice |
| ~a      | *psv.*     | cut              |
### Implied meaning
- cutting
### Etymology
#### Glyph
Supposedly inspired by an Egyptian hieroglyph 𓌜 (knife) but looks more like 𓇋 (reed)
#### Sound
- *a priori:* ks=destruction, i=sharp
